title: Will Naphtha Keep Cracking
summary:
Naphtha has been a key driver for the LR product trades
Naphtha refers to a range of volatile and flammable liquids produced by the distillation of petroleum. The liquids have various uses, including as components of gasoline and kerosene. Naphtha is also widely used as a solvent.
